config.authorization: Owner said continue after proposal to separate BTC state features from direction/residual and diagnose degraded high-score tail.
config.group_caveat: ETH residual internally uses trailing7day beta. This ablates model input columns, not independent or orthogonal economic information.
config.gate: Unchanged expected native netR>0; no calibration/threshold change.
config.training: Identical expanding complete NY weeks, label expiry<=test-quarter start, equal total weight per NY week, same LightGBM settings and raw native netR objective.
config.execution: Reuse original entry/target/stop/NY expiry/cached native fees. VectorBT evaluates new admission columns only; all original/full-context/unscored/single-feature selections reused. One position per asset; independent1dollar original risk, not funded-account return.
config.statistics: Six new arm-target tests; Holm across6 matched-control tests and separately across12 improvements versus original/full-context. Report both, with weekly bootstrap2000/signflip10000. Historical evidence requires net CI>0, matched Holm<.01, original-improvement Holm<.01 and improvement CI>0. No promotion or choosing a target on test profit.
config.tail_diagnostic: Near target only. Within each quarter choose ceil(10percent*n) by score, as in previous study; diagnostic not an executable trade gate. Compare promoted/displaced/shared events for original/full/state/return models; include all quarters, failed outcomes, matched controls and repeated-week counts.
config.attribution: Explain original and full-context near models on all333 complete test events. Native TreeSHAP exact netR and SHAP0.52 tree-path-dependent parity; also interventional training-only background of first event per NY week, at most100 evenly spaced weeks, identical event IDs across paired models. Save Explanation objects and check additivity. Decompose full-minus-original score into base change, shared-feature attribution change, beta/correlation and return/residual sums. Descriptive model behavior, not market causality or feature-deletion effect.
config.historical_use: Known exploratory history including prior feature-screening results. No untouched confirmation. All barriers/costs/time boundaries frozen. Current incomplete week inference only.

diagnostics.ranking_basis: Within-fold AUC weighted by eligible test rows; top decile selected separately in every fold. Not a trading gate.
